How the agents clash launches for a workflow item behave.

Models · Claude Code

What a workflow session launched on Claude Code runs on. Applied at launch and every time the session is resumed.

Models · OMP

What a workflow session launched on OMP runs on — names are matched by omp, against the providers you configured there. Applied at launch and on every resume.

Ticket trackers

Where your tickets live. Workflow agents link every ticket key they write, and an item's ↗ Share… can post to the ticket. Jira and Linear keys look alike (PS-123, ENG-42), so a key belongs to the tracker that lists its prefix, and any other key to the primary tracker — both can run side by side during a migration. With no tracker set, agents ask you for the host.

Jira

Slack & Discord

Where else ↗ Share… can send an item's document, and who posts it: an agent session or clash itself over the webhooks below. Neither falls back to the other, and nothing is sent without you pressing a button.

Notifications

Announce items that park waiting for you. Only agent-driven transitions post — never your own clicks — and this always uses a webhook: it fires with nobody watching, so a skill session would be a notification you'd have to go read.
